mapper.sql: h.history_id AS id, h.history_id, h.user_id, h.data_id, h.generation_description AS description, h.generation_code AS chart_code, h.generation_description AS user_input, h.generation_code AS ai_response, COALESCE(d.data_name, '') AS file_name, h.generation_path, h.generation_time AS created_at, h.generation_time AS updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM generation_history h LEFT JOIN data_file d ON h.data_id = d.data_id WHERE h.history_id = #{historyId} AND h.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
